ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on both lobes. A prominent vertical black stripe bisects the center from the median notch to the peduncle base. Dark pigmented margins border the entire trailing edge. A localized tan/orange pigmented blob is located on the mid-left lobe. Sparse black micro-speckling is distributed throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations along the primary trailing edge boundary. High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged edges) are concentrated at the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a mild sigmoidal curve, transitioning from slightly convex near the center to slightly concave at the outer lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are visible on the distal right lobe and along the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent diagonal linear dark pixel disruption on the left lobe. Multiple smaller, unaligned linear rake marks are visible on the interior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct yellowish-brown discoloration patch on the medial-left lobe. Minor irregular notch/missing tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation forms a distinctive anchor-like geometric pattern where the lobes meet the peduncle.
